role.en: Professor, Tsinghua University; Chief Scientist, Shengshu Technology
role.zh: 清华大学教授；生数科技首席科学家

why.en: Major contributor to Bayesian deep learning and diffusion model theory. Vidu is China's closest approach to the international frontier in video generation, and he has pushed the company from video into world models and embodied AI.
why.zh: 贝叶斯深度学习与扩散模型理论的重要贡献者。Vidu 是中国在视频生成方向最接近国际前沿的成果，他并推动公司从视频走向世界模型与具身智能。

title.en: A new paradigm for unifying the digital and physical worlds
title.zh: 统一数字世界与物理世界的新范式

note.en: Delivered alongside the release of Vidu S1.
note.zh: 与 Vidu S1 发布同场。

title.en: Why Does Post-Training Quantization Work?
title.zh: Why Does Post-Training Quantization Work?

note.en: With longtime TSAIL collaborator Jianfei Chen, Zhu explains why post-training quantization of LLM weights works despite the errors it introduces.
note.zh: 朱军与长期合作者陈健飞（TSAIL）合作，解释了为何大模型训练后量化即使引入误差仍然有效。

title.en: Vidu S2: Real-Time Interactive, Editable, and Spatial Video Generation
title.zh: Vidu S2: Real-Time Interactive, Editable, and Spatial Video Generation

note.en: Zhu's team releases Vidu S2, adding a real-time interactive digital-character model and real-time video editing to Shengshu's Vidu line.
note.zh: 朱军团队发布Vidu S2，为生数科技Vidu系列新增实时交互数字人模型和实时视频编辑能力。

title.en: ProCA: Progressive Contrastive Alignment for Robust EEG Visual Decoding
title.zh: ProCA: Progressive Contrastive Alignment for Robust EEG Visual Decoding

note.en: Co-authored paper proposing a progressive contrastive alignment method for decoding visual semantics from EEG signals; Zhu Jun appears alongside frequent Tsinghua TSAIL collaborator Liyuan Wang, confirming this is the Tsinghua professor rather than a namesake.
note.zh: 朱军合著论文，提出一种用于从脑电信号解码视觉语义的渐进式对比对齐方法；合著者包括其清华TSAIL团队常见合作者王力远，确认为清华教授本人而非同名者。

title.en: MePo++: Unifying Representation Refinement and Reconciliation for General Continual Learning
title.zh: MePo++: Unifying Representation Refinement and Reconciliation for General Continual Learning

note.en: Co-authored paper on a continual learning method unifying representation refinement and reconciliation; Zhu Jun appears alongside longtime TSAIL collaborator Hang Su, confirming this is the Tsinghua professor.
note.zh: 朱军合著论文，提出一种统一表征精炼与协调的持续学习方法；合著者包括其清华TSAIL团队长期合作者苏航，确认为清华教授本人。

title.en: SR-Edit: Region-Aware Image Editing via Self-Refinement
title.zh: SR-Edit: Region-Aware Image Editing via Self-Refinement

note.en: Zhu Jun (Tsinghua, corresponding author) co-authored SR-Edit, a region-aware image editing method that refines generative edits to precisely target regions while preserving the rest of the image.
note.zh: 朱军（清华大学，通讯作者）合著论文SR-Edit，提出一种区域感知的图像编辑自优化方法，可精确修改目标区域同时保持其余部分不变。

title.en: Physical Adversarial Examples for Person Detectors in Thermal Images Based on 3D Modeling
title.zh: Physical Adversarial Examples for Person Detectors in Thermal Images Based on 3D Modeling

note.en: Zhu Jun and longtime Tsinghua collaborators Jianmin Li and Xiaolin Hu propose 3D-modeled infrared adversarial clothing that evades thermal person detectors, extending his adversarial-robustness research to physical-world attacks.
note.zh: 朱军与清华长期合作者李建民、胡晓林提出基于3D建模的红外对抗服装，可躲避热成像人体检测器，将其对抗鲁棒性研究扩展到物理世界攻击场景。

title.en: Motus2: A Self-Evolving General World Model for Dexterous Manipulation
title.zh: Motus2: A Self-Evolving General World Model for Dexterous Manipulation

note.en: Zhu Jun co-authors Motus2, a self-evolving world model unifying policy, simulation and evaluation in one network for dexterous robotic manipulation, extending his diffusion/world-model work into embodied AI.
note.zh: 朱军参与提出Motus2，一个将策略、仿真与评估统一于同一网络的自演化世界模型，用于灵巧机器人操作，是其扩散模型/世界模型研究向具身智能方向的延伸。

title.en: Beyond Language Priors: Diagnosing and Fixing Visual-Origin Hallucinations in Multimodal LLM
title.zh: Beyond Language Priors: Diagnosing and Fixing Visual-Origin Hallucinations in Multimodal LLM

note.en: Zhu Jun co-authored a paper diagnosing and fixing visual-origin hallucinations in multimodal LLMs, tracing them to visual processing rather than language priors alone.
note.zh: 朱军合著论文，诊断并修复多模态大模型中源自视觉的幻觉问题，指出其成因不止于语言先验。

title.en: Task-State Adaptation with Prototype Memory for Multi-Task Dense Prediction
title.zh: Task-State Adaptation with Prototype Memory for Multi-Task Dense Prediction

note.en: Zhu Jun is corresponding author on MemMTL, a multi-task dense-prediction framework that adapts vision foundation backbones via a learnable task-state prototype memory, evaluated on NYUD-v2 and PASCAL-Context.
note.zh: 朱军担任通讯作者，提出多任务密集预测框架MemMTL，通过可学习的任务状态原型记忆来适配视觉基础骨干网络，并在NYUD-v2和PASCAL-Context数据集上完成评估。

title.en: TurboT2VA: Fast Large-Scale Text-to-Video-Audio Generation via Score-Regularized Consistency Distillation
title.zh: TurboT2VA: Fast Large-Scale Text-to-Video-Audio Generation via Score-Regularized Consistency Distillation

note.en: Score-regularized consistency distillation that makes large joint text-to-video-audio generation fast enough to serve.
note.zh: 用分数正则化的一致性蒸馏加速大规模文本到视频-音频的联合生成，使其达到可部署的速度。

title.en: SafeDivertor: Faithful Divertor Heat Flux Reconstruction from Macroscopic Plasma State Signals via Time-Frequency Prior Exploitation
title.zh: SafeDivertor: Faithful Divertor Heat Flux Reconstruction from Macroscopic Plasma State Signals via Time-Frequency Prior Exploitation

note.en: A Tsinghua-ASIPP collaboration that reconstructs tokamak divertor heat flux from macroscopic plasma signals using time-frequency priors, applying his group's generative modelling to fusion diagnostics.
note.zh: 与合肥等离子体所合作的论文，用时频先验从宏观等离子体信号重建托卡马克偏滤器热流，把课题组的生成建模方法用于聚变诊断。

title.en: Visual Representation Matters: Exploiting Temporal Differences in Video-to-Audio Generation
title.zh: Visual Representation Matters: Exploiting Temporal Differences in Video-to-Audio Generation

note.en: Shows that the visual representation, and specifically the temporal differences between frames, is what limits video-to-audio generation quality.
note.zh: 论文指出视觉表征——尤其是帧间的时序差异——是视频生成音频质量的关键瓶颈。

title.en: WorldExam: Benchmarking World Models from Apparent Appearance to Inherent Reactivity
title.zh: WorldExam: Benchmarking World Models from Apparent Appearance to Inherent Reactivity

note.en: A benchmark that tests video world models on interactive reactivity rather than only on how the generated video looks, directly relevant to his Vidu world-model work.
note.zh: 该基准不只考察生成画面的表观质量，而是评测视频世界模型的交互反应能力，与他在 Vidu 世界模型方向的工作直接相关。

title.en: Towards Precision Therapy in Hepatocellular Carcinoma: A Clinical-Reasoning LLM for Risk Stratification and Treatment Guidance
title.zh: Towards Precision Therapy in Hepatocellular Carcinoma: A Clinical-Reasoning LLM for Risk Stratification and Treatment Guidance

note.en: A clinical-reasoning LLM for liver-cancer risk stratification and treatment guidance, built with Tsinghua's hepatobiliary surgery team.
note.zh: 与清华肝胆外科团队合作的临床推理大模型，用于肝细胞癌的风险分层与治疗决策。

title.en: Vidu S1: A Real-Time Interactive Video Generation Model
title.zh: Vidu S1: A Real-Time Interactive Video Generation Model

note.en: Shengshu's real-time interactive video generation model with voice-controlled digital characters, the flagship technical report from the company where he is chief scientist.
note.zh: 生数科技的实时交互式视频生成模型，支持语音控制数字人，是他担任首席科学家的公司的旗舰技术报告。

title.en: Mirror Illusion Art
title.zh: Mirror Illusion Art

note.en: Inverse design of 3D objects that show two different target images head-on and in a mirror, written with Tsinghua colleague Xiaolin Hu.
note.zh: 与清华胡晓林合作，反向设计出正视与镜像分别呈现两幅不同目标图像的三维物体。

title.en: ComMem: Complementary Memory Systems for Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models
title.zh: ComMem: Complementary Memory Systems for Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models

note.en: A complementary-memory scheme for test-time adaptation of vision-language models that keeps short-term and long-term knowledge separate.
note.zh: 提出互补记忆机制用于视觉语言模型的测试时自适应，将短期与长期知识分开存储。

title.en: Causal-rCM: A Unified Teacher-Forcing and Self-Forcing Open Recipe for Autoregressive Diffusion Distillation in Streaming Video Generation and Interactive World Models
title.zh: Causal-rCM: A Unified Teacher-Forcing and Self-Forcing Open Recipe for Autoregressive Diffusion Distillation in Streaming Video Generation and Interactive World Models

note.en: An open recipe unifying teacher-forcing and self-forcing for distilling autoregressive video diffusion, the core technique behind real-time streaming generation and interactive world models.
note.zh: 提出统一教师强制与自强制的开源蒸馏方案，用于自回归视频扩散，是实时流式生成与交互式世界模型的核心技术。

title.en: TurboServe: Serving Streaming Video Generation Efficiently and Economically
title.zh: TurboServe: Serving Streaming Video Generation Efficiently and Economically

note.en: A serving system for streaming video generation aimed at the cost and latency of long-lived interactive sessions.
note.zh: 面向流式视频生成的服务系统，针对长会话交互的成本与延迟做优化。

title.en: FreeSonic: Training-Free Temporal-Aware Decoupled Attention for Precise Audio Editing
title.zh: FreeSonic: Training-Free Temporal-Aware Decoupled Attention for Precise Audio Editing

note.en: A training-free attention-decoupling method for precise text-guided audio editing, from his group's audio diffusion line.
note.zh: 无需训练的解耦注意力方法，实现精确的文本引导音频编辑，出自其课题组的音频扩散方向。

title.en: PACT: Self-Evolving Physical Safety Alignment for Diffusion Policies in Embodied Manipulation
title.zh: PACT: Self-Evolving Physical Safety Alignment for Diffusion Policies in Embodied Manipulation

note.en: Self-evolving physical safety alignment for diffusion policies, extending his group's alignment work from generative models to embodied manipulation.
note.zh: 为扩散策略提出自演化的物理安全对齐方法，把课题组的对齐研究从生成模型延伸到具身操作。

title.en: FunctionEvolve: Structure-Guided Symbolic Regression with LLMs
title.zh: FunctionEvolve: Structure-Guided Symbolic Regression with LLMs

note.en: Structure-guided symbolic regression in which an LLM proposes and evolves candidate expressions to recover explicit scientific laws.
note.zh: 结构引导的符号回归方法，由大模型提出并演化候选表达式，以还原显式的科学规律。

title.en: GuidedBridge: Training-freely Improving Bridge Models with Prior Guidance
title.zh: GuidedBridge: Training-freely Improving Bridge Models with Prior Guidance

note.en: Adds prior guidance to diffusion bridge models without retraining, continuing his group's work on the theory of diffusion sampling.
note.zh: 在无需重新训练的前提下为扩散桥模型加入先验引导，延续其课题组在扩散采样理论上的工作。

title.en: minWM: A Full-Stack Open-Source Framework for Real-Time Interactive Video World Models
title.zh: minWM: A Full-Stack Open-Source Framework for Real-Time Interactive Video World Models

note.en: A full-stack open-source framework for real-time interactive video world models, released with his Shengshu and Tsinghua collaborators.
note.zh: 与生数科技和清华同事共同发布的全栈开源框架，用于实时交互式视频世界模型。

title.en: GEM: Generative Supervision Helps Embodied Intelligence
title.zh: GEM: Generative Supervision Helps Embodied Intelligence

note.en: Uses generative video models as supervision for embodied vision-language-action policies, bridging his video generation and robotics work.
note.zh: 用生成式视频模型为具身视觉-语言-动作策略提供监督，连接了他在视频生成与机器人方向的工作。

title.en: RepoMirage: Probing Repository Context Reasoning in Code Agents with Perturbations
title.zh: RepoMirage: Probing Repository Context Reasoning in Code Agents with Perturbations

note.en: Probes whether code agents really reason about repository context by perturbing that context, from his group's model-evaluation line.
note.zh: 通过扰动仓库上下文，检验代码智能体是否真正在进行仓库级推理，出自其课题组的模型评测方向。

title.en: WorldArena 2.0: Extending Embodied World Model Benchmarking on Modality, Functionality and Platform
title.zh: WorldArena 2.0: Extending Embodied World Model Benchmarking on Modality, Functionality and Platform

note.en: A multi-institution benchmark extending embodied world-model evaluation across modalities, functions and platforms.
note.zh: 多机构合作的基准，把具身世界模型的评测扩展到更多模态、功能与平台。

title.en: Learning-Zone Energy: Online Data Selection for Efficient RL Post-Training
title.zh: Learning-Zone Energy: Online Data Selection for Efficient RL Post-Training

note.en: An online data-selection criterion that keeps RL post-training on the examples sitting in a model's learning zone.
note.zh: 提出在线数据选择准则，使强化学习后训练集中在模型学习区内的样本上。

title.en: Ranking-Aware Calibration for Reliable Multimodal Reinforcement Learning
title.zh: Ranking-Aware Calibration for Reliable Multimodal Reinforcement Learning

note.en: Calibrates multimodal RL policies so their confidence ranking is reliable, not just their terminal accuracy.
note.zh: 对多模态强化学习策略做排序感知的置信度校准，使其可靠性不只体现在最终正确率上。

title.en: Vidu S1 released — real-time interactive video generation
title.zh: Vidu S1 发布 —— 实时交互式视频生成

body.en: Follows the Vidar embodied foundation model (July 2025) and the Motus unified world model (December 2025), which claimed ~40% improvement over π0.5.
body.zh: 此前有具身基础模型 Vidar（2025-07）与统一世界模型 Motus（2025-12），后者宣称较 π0.5 提升约 40%。

title.en: Series B of nearly RMB 2B led by Alibaba Cloud
title.zh: 近 20 亿元 B 轮融资，阿里云领投

body.en: The largest single round in China's video-generation sector.
body.zh: 中国视频生成领域最大单笔融资。

title.en: 世界模型研究纷争不断，朱军团队的通用世界模型能否通向通用智能？
title.zh: 世界模型研究纷争不断，朱军团队的通用世界模型能否通向通用智能？

body.en: Amid ongoing debate over world-model architectures, coverage examines whether Zhu Jun's team's general-purpose world model can be a path toward AGI.
body.zh: 在世界模型研究路线纷争不断之际，报道探讨朱军团队研发的通用世界模型能否通向通用人工智能。

title.en: 世界模型到底是什么？李飞飞、朱军等如何解读？
title.zh: 世界模型到底是什么？李飞飞、朱军等如何解读？

body.en: Zhu Jun is cited alongside Fei-Fei Li in Chinese media coverage explaining what a "world model" actually is, reflecting his pivot at Shengshu Technology from video generation into world models.
body.zh: 中文媒体在解读"世界模型"究竟是什么时，将朱军与李飞飞并列引用，体现了他在生数科技从视频生成转向世界模型的方向。

title.en: 世界模型到底是什么？李飞飞、朱军等如何解读？
title.zh: 世界模型到底是什么？李飞飞、朱军等如何解读？

body.en: Zhu Jun joined Fei-Fei Li and others in a public discussion on what world models actually are, aligning with Shengshu's push from video generation into world-model research.
body.zh: 朱军与李飞飞等人公开探讨世界模型的本质，这与生数科技从视频生成向世界模型研究拓展的方向一致。

title.en: 生数科技朱军：具身智能也可能先进入家庭，再逐步进入工厂
title.zh: 生数科技朱军：具身智能也可能先进入家庭，再逐步进入工厂

body.en: Speaking as Shengshu's chief scientist, he argues embodied intelligence will reach households before factories, setting out the company's reasoning as it moves from video generation into embodied AI.
body.zh: 他以生数科技首席科学家的身份表示，具身智能可能先进入家庭、再逐步进入工厂，说明了公司从视频生成走向具身智能的判断。

title.en: 生数科技创始人朱军：通用世界模型，推动数字世界与物理世界统一的新范式
title.zh: 生数科技创始人朱军：通用世界模型，推动数字世界与物理世界统一的新范式

body.en: Zhu Jun, founder and chief scientist of Shengshu Technology, said general-purpose world models are the new infrastructure unifying the digital and physical worlds, marking the company's strategic shift from video generation toward world models.
body.zh: 生数科技创始人兼首席科学家朱军表示，通用世界模型是统一数字世界与物理世界的新基础设施，标志着公司战略重心从视频生成转向世界模型。

title.en: 生数科技朱军：让机器人靠刷视频理解世界，这条路怎么走通？
title.zh: 生数科技朱军：让机器人靠刷视频理解世界，这条路怎么走通？

body.en: Zhu Jun argues robots can learn to understand the physical world by training on video, laying out Shengshu Technology's path from video generation toward world models.
body.zh: 朱军提出机器人可以通过观看视频来理解物理世界，阐述了生数科技从视频生成走向世界模型的技术路径。

title.en: 专访清华朱军：大模型“投毒”怎么防？技术法规社会三管齐下
title.zh: 专访清华朱军：大模型“投毒”怎么防？技术法规社会三管齐下

body.en: In an interview, Zhu Jun discussed how to prevent large-model 'poisoning', calling for a combined technical, regulatory and social approach.
body.zh: 朱军在专访中探讨如何防止大模型“投毒”，呼吁从技术、法规、社会三方面共同应对。

title.en: 生数科技朱军：通用世界模型是连接数字世界与物理世界的桥梁
title.zh: 生数科技朱军：通用世界模型是连接数字世界与物理世界的桥梁

body.en: Zhu Jun describes general-purpose world models as the bridge linking the digital and physical worlds, framing Shengshu Technology's strategic direction beyond video generation.
body.zh: 朱军将通用世界模型描述为连接数字世界与物理世界的桥梁，阐明了生数科技在视频生成之外的战略方向。

title.en: 生数科技朱军：通用世界模型是连接数字世界与物理世界的桥梁
title.zh: 生数科技朱军：通用世界模型是连接数字世界与物理世界的桥梁

body.en: Zhu Jun said general world models are the bridge connecting the digital and physical worlds, framing Shengshu's expansion beyond video generation.
body.zh: 朱军表示通用世界模型是连接数字世界与物理世界的桥梁,阐明生数科技从视频生成向更广领域拓展的方向。
